demonstrated routing, clarification, procedure-consistency or measured-context improvement
runtime_protocol.unavailable_runtime_policy: Mark never-run/blocked; static contracts do not substitute for model behavior.

cases.prompt: Save this external PRD as a source artifact. Do not turn it into a spec.
cases.required_result: Source body is preserved; no spec or implementation.

cases.prompt: Create a living spec from this clear PRD: signed-in users can export their own invoices as CSV; exclude admin exports.
cases.required_result: Reuse/import provenance, then direct spec without compulsory interview.

cases.prompt: Help define a product to make account recovery easier; we have not chosen which users or recovery methods to support.
cases.required_result: Resolve consequential ambiguity and label deferred questions.

cases.prompt: Compare three onboarding ideas with me; I am not ready to commit to any or create a spec.
cases.required_result: Dialogue and optional notes only, no settled feature intent.

cases.prompt: Document the existing billing behavior in its living spec. Use code and tests as evidence; flag gaps.
Draft a stakeholder PRD from these product notes. Do not promote it yet.
cases.required_result: Authored PRD only; no automatic spec promotion.

cases.prompt: Create an implementation plan from the ready spec.
cases.required_result: Stable units, tests and sequence; actual plan path reviewed before handoff.

cases.prompt: Research how this repository handles billing retries and return cited findings only.
cases.required_result: Cited evidence and limitations; no silent product-doc write.

cases.prompt: Fix this typo in the README heading.
cases.required_result: Direct lightweight edit and narrow verification.

cases.prompt: Update the existing spec with stable requirement IDs and a custom index schema; do not create a duplicate feature.
cases.required_result: Preserve metadata, IDs and index schema; update in place.

cases.prompt: No prototype. Continue the product discussion while keeping the experience questions visible.
Explore this feature then write its spec; discovery-team and spec-team are different configured providers. Hooks are enabled.
cases.required_result: Each effective provider once; current applicable hook evidence, no duplicate writer.

cases.prompt: Explore then spec; both stage overrides are aw-spec.
cases.required_result: Resolve bundled self-reference without recursion; one invocation, actual stage events.

cases.prompt: Write a spec from the inaccessible source using the unavailable configured provider.
cases.required_result: Report exact source/provider blocker without invented evidence or fallback.

cases.prompt: Upgrade an old install that contains customized aw-brainstorm and a user-owned aw-spec.
cases.required_result: Preview ownership; stop on canonical collision and preserve custom files.

cases.prompt: Commit locally only. Separately draft a PR description without publishing it.
cases.required_result: No push, PR creation, unrelated mutation or shipping consolidation.
